bodyText: Taven Saste BUĎTE ZDRÁVI • COMMUNITY CRISIS & RIGHTS HUB EN CZ ROM Emergency Contacts (112) 112 SOS 150 Fire 155 Medical 158 Police Home Safety Steps My Rights Free Aid Kit Community Match Regional hub CRISIS STEPS, RIGHTS AND MUTUAL AID Taven Saste. Stay safe. Know your rights. Stand together. Fast crisis steps, free aid kits, and legal help for our community. My Rights Order Free Kit Community is the first help. We help you organise it. Where are you now? Pick one phase. Steps and rights follow it. PRE-CRISIS Prepare now. Top free steps first. The kit covers the rest. Open steps DURING CRISIS Stay safe now. Grab and go. Never stay alone. Open steps POST-CRISIS Recover & claim rights. Report damage. Claim what you are owed. Open steps Safety Steps Checklists by priority. Tick as you go. My Rights Pick what applies. Get one clear plan. Free Aid Kit Hygiene, warmth, water and food. Free. Community Match Ask for help or offer it nearby. Can't buy supplies? Start with the free steps. Our kit covers the rest. In danger right now? Call 112. Free, 24 hours, any phone. Say the street and how many people. Call 112 Taven Saste Disaster preparedness, legal rights and community mutual aid for the Romani community in the Czech Republic. Built with Romani NGOs and legal advisors. Free to use, no account needed. EXPLORE Safety Steps My Rights Free Aid Kit Community Match Regional hub Emergency numbers 112, 150, 155 and 158 are real. Contacts marked as placeholders are waiting for verified local partner data. Made with AI in Macaly ×
